scenario.title: Wound check, dismissive consultation
scenario.patient_background: Second visit for the same concern, feels unheard.
patient_concerns: Why is my wound still red and sore?

transcript.content: Right, let's have a look at that cannula site.
It's still really red and it hurts, is that normal?
It's fine, just deal with it, it happens to everyone.
It's been like this for a week though.
You'll be discharged tomorrow anyway. Any other issues?

audio.note: This benchmark contains no real audio recordings for any case. Base Intelligibility and Fluency on genuine acoustic evidence only; since none exists here, mark both status="limited_evidence", level=null for every case in this package. Do not infer pronunciation or spoken fluency from transcript spelling or word choice.
